title: Multi-Level Reinforced Concrete Structural Frame & Cantilevered Deck Construction
shortDescription: Construction of a 3-storey reinforced concrete framed building with full-height staging, timber falsework propping, cantilevered balcony slabs, and integrated structural staircase.
overview: A multi-level structural building construction project in South-West Nigeria demonstrating integrated concrete framing capabilities. The project features a monolithic cast-in-place reinforced concrete skeleton comprising ground-to-roof columns, floor beams, cantilevered balcony projections, and cast-in-place reinforced concrete staircases.
objectives: Construct a laterally stable multi-storey skeleton that optimizes internal clear spans and satisfies statutory physical planning and structural regulations.
scopeOfWork: Ground-to-roof structural staging, timber and tubular steel propping, rebar fixing, monolithic concrete casting, staircase framing, and curing supervision.
technicalApproach: Floor-by-floor staging with vertical props sized for wet-concrete loads plus construction live traffic, cross-braced access towers, and sequential de-shuttering tied to curing milestones.
projectOutcome: Multi-level reinforced concrete skeleton delivered with consistent dimensional tolerances ready for masonry infill and architectural facade treatments.

metaDescription: Construction case study of a 3-storey reinforced concrete framed building and cantilevered slabs by SPES Swiftpace.
